species.real: A salt pond works when the sun evaporates seawater faster than it seeps in, and the brine often turns pink from salt-loving algae and microbes.
species.name: Saltcrust

dex.text: Grows a white rime in the pans overnight and calls it character. Quite possibly the only creature on the island that has never gone out in the sun on purpose.
dex.fact: Anguilla's coastal salt ponds were once raked for sea salt, long a mainstay of the island's economy.
